title: record page open: the same record GET is issued twice concurrently and security/explain four times — the in-flight GET sharing from objectui#5544 covers only the callers that opted in
body:
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed task (provenance below) — on the admission classes alone this is an observation (objectui#8014 closed the two-call form `not_planned`, and its reopen condition — record-open latency measured with explain as a named contributor — is not met by this run); the maintainer asked for it as its own card.
Reader: objectui triage first-touch → `domain:ui` lane (`packages/types/src/http-inflight.ts` callers, `packages/plugin-detail` / `packages/app-shell` record page).
Dedup (semantic search, open + closed, objectui): "record page fetches the same record twice concurrently, duplicate GET data record, security explain four requests" → 3 hits, all closed: objectui#8014 (`not_planned`, explain ×2), objectui#5544 (completed — boot duplicates of `runtime/config` and `auth/me/localization`, fixed by sharing one in-flight GET).

Environment: framework `ce577ec4` showcase booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on its own port and SQLite file; console = objectui `f9f4a62d` (`apps/console` Vite dev server, and a production `vite build` for timings); Chromium 141 headless, 1440×900, seeded admin.

## Measurement — production build, record page full reload, 4 runs (2 record-page, 2 home), all consistent

Requests captured with Playwright `request` / `requestfinished` events (resource timing is not usable here: the eager chunks fill its 250-entry buffer before the first API call).

- `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task/:id` — **×2 concurrent, identical URL** (one run ×3).
- `POST /api/v1/security/explain` — **×4 concurrent** (bodies not compared; objectui#8014 measured ×2 per open).
- `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task?populate=…` — ×2 sequential, same query prefix (full query strings not compared).
- `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` — ×2 sequential; `GET /api/v1/runtime/config` — ×2 sequential in 2 of 4 runs.
- `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_user_preference/:id` (`ui.recent`) — ×2 sequential per visit (each audited; see objectstack-ai/objectui#11672 item 5).
- Not duplicates (checked): the three `sys_user_preference` GETs read three different keys (`ui.recent`, `ui.favorites`, `ui.flow.palette.recents`); the two `approvals/requests` and two `sys_activity` GETs carry different queries.

Totals per record-page reload: 41–44 API calls.

## Where

`packages/types/src/http-inflight.ts` shares one in-flight GET **only for callers that route through it** (its header names `runtime/config` and `auth/me/localization`); the record GET's two concurrent callers and the explain callers do not. Sequential repeats (`get-session`, `runtime/config`, the list query) are outside its design (no response cache by intent).

## Expected

One request per distinct resource per record open: the record fetched once and shared, the explain verdicts batched or shared; sequential repeats either removed at the caller or explicitly accepted.

Provenance: filed as a separate card on the maintainer's explicit instruction in the dispatching session, which lifts the per-fire filing quota for this batch of seven, verbatim — 「重新思考以上和用户体验相关的问题，哪些需要立卡」 then 「分开立 7 张」. Found during a browser dogfood sweep of the console; companion checklist card objectstack-ai/objectui#11672. Filed by session `session_01WEARdKfDHDT7rTuEhLyT1k`.
